logic.title: Logical Flow
logic.intro: The twelve argument positions are not isolated essays. Each one answers a question raised by the one before it, and together they form a cumulative case for the truth of John 14:6. Use the numbered links below to move through the sequence, or open any position directly to see which encyclopedia entries have been assigned to it.

positions.intro: Edit this introduction in src/data/positions.json. Tagged entries link to the encyclopedia; their full articles are not copied here.

positions.title: Position 12
positions.label: The Invitation — John 14:6
positions.intro: Edit this introduction in src/data/positions.json. This is the culminating position where the cumulative case arrives at the claim of John 14:6.
